high_level_description: The image depicts a formal meeting or discussion taking place in a modern conference room. The setting is well-lit with natural light coming through large windows on the right side of the room. The walls are white, and there is a large screen mounted on the left wall, which appears to be turned off. In the center of the room, there is a round table where four individuals are seated. Two men and two women are engaged in conversation. One man is wearing a dark suit and tie, while the other is dressed in a lighter-colored suit.
